answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on a lotus plot. Five neighbors must each whisper approval, capped at three claims per epoch. A dispute sends a ripple through the five signers: a false claim burns the bond plus 20 credits from each signer. The k-th fake pays five rented signatures at 24+4(k-1) credits each, so 1,000 fakes cost 10,110,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 120 once and keeps the bond.
